title: Orange and ricotta pancakes with strawberries

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oranges, ricotta, eggs, milk, flour, strawberries, honey, butter and natural yoghurt are all plain home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including ricotta and May strawberries, is an everyday item at Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, whisk, grater and frying pan, and frying spoonfuls of batter is beginner technique.

works.reason: 200g self-raising flour, 250g ricotta, three eggs and 150ml milk make a thick batter that gives plenty of pancakes for four, and the frying heat and time are clear.

honest_times.reason: Thirty active minutes is believable for zesting, peeling and slicing the fruit and frying the pancakes in batches, and it fits the standard pace.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the salt are used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Oranges carry the dish through both the zest in the batter and the fruit on top, and a fresh fruit breakfast with early strawberries suits early May.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, British and easy to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Ricotta, eggs, yoghurt and plenty of fruit make this a proper family breakfast rather than a sugary treat.
